key_findings: ALL FOUR citation role embeddings (citing, following, criticizing, all_weighted) PASS both adversarial gates on frozen harness v3 (999 decisions)
Very high jurist preference (0.8488) confirms citation heritage as dominant jurist-preference signal even without semantic legal structure
Zero jurivoc alignment (L0 NMI=0.0) and zero scale stability confirm pure citation signals lack legal structure
Negative boilerplate resistance (-0.555) is consistent with citation signals not being dominated by procedural text
Alpha blends with cp64 maintain both adversarial gate passage (lang_dom~0.51, jurist~0.77) while potentially improving legal structure coverage
Results extend established citation-signal pattern (previously documented for cited_decisions_tfidf: jurist=0.6922) to pure citation role signals from BGE/ATF resolution pipeline
Sparse role failures replicate: distinguishing and overruling too sparse to pass jurist gate (consistent with prior findings of 58/18 annotations)
negative_results: Pure citation role embeddings have zero jurivoc alignment (L0 NMI=0.0) — no recoverable legal taxonomy structure
Pure citation role embeddings have zero scale stability (0.0) — neighbor structure not preserved under corpus reduction
Pure citation role embeddings have negative boilerplate resistance (-0.555) — unlike metric learning baselines which show resistance_score ≈ -0.74 to -0.92
Alpha blends improve neither jurivoc nor scale stability beyond the baseline cp64 behavior
next_recommendation: CONTINUE_WITHIN_MISSION_ON_CORPUS_DELIVERY — citation role embedding results are consistent with existing evidence; no change to blocked objectives (full corpus scale, jurist human study)
